commit_message:
refactor: rename util.ts to strings.ts, add truncateMiddle

Also make wrap() handle words longer than the width.
summary: Rename util.ts -> strings.ts (tests moved verbatim) plus two behaviour changes: wrap() now splits long words (at hyphens or hard), and a new truncateMiddle(). The moved wrap tests never use a word longer than the width, and the truncateMiddle tests check only length and the ellipsis.

defects.description: The wrap() behaviour change (splitLong: hyphen splits and hard breaks for words longer than width) has no test; the moved tests pass on the old implementation (every word fits), so splitLong's mutants survive or have no coverage (`word.length <= width`, `hyphen > 0`, `hyphen + 1`, the lastIndexOf bound). Tests need a hyphenated long word (e.g. "state-of-the-art" at width 8) and an unhyphenated one longer than width.

`shortens long strings` only asserts the length and that `…` appears, so how the kept characters are split between head and tail (Math.ceil vs floor, `keep - head`) and the `max <= 1` edge are unpinned. Exact expectations are needed, e.g. truncateMiddle("abcdefghijklmnop", 9) === "abcd…mnop", an even split case, and max = 1 / 0.
